The '''''Vigil''-class corvette''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Description==
Produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], the ''Vigil'' class was considered the smallest vessel in the iconic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] line of ships.<ref name="AOR CRB" />

With a dagger-shaped hull, heavy armament, and relatively large crew complement for its class, the ''Vigil'' class shared many iconic design features of a true destroyer. The exception to this was the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command deck]], which sat flush with the hull to the aft over the main drive engines, giving the ''Vigil'' class a smaller silhouette and better protection than a tall and exposed command tower.<ref name="AOR CRB" />

For its primary armament, the ''Vigil'' class was true to its destroyer origins, carrying a trio of turret-mounted dual heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets on the dorsal hull that gave it an exceedingly heavy punch for its class. Further supplementing its armament were a trio of lighter turbolaser turrets, along with smaller anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="AOR CRB" />

Thanks to their size and role, these ships rarely served in the line of battle with larger types of star destroyers. Instead they patrolled trade routes, escorted cruisers as picket ships, served as battlegroup leaders for small backwater fleets, operated as lone cruisers hunting [[pirate]]s and [[smuggler]]s, and generally served where a larger destroyer was deemed excessive or wasteful.<ref name="AOR CRB" />

==History==
[[File:Naval_Station_Validusia.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Several ''Vigil''-class ships flying near [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']]]]
Several ''Vigil''-class corvettes were serviced at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']].<ref name="EGW" /> The corvettes patrolled trade routes, acted as battle group leaders in small fleets, and hunted [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] alone. They were also used as [[Scout/Legends|scoutcraft]].<ref name="AOR CRB" />
[[File:VigilClassCorvette-Fractalsponge.jpg|thumb|Ansel Hsiao's model from Fractalsponge]]

==Behind the scenes==
<div style="float:right"></div>
This corvette originated as a [[fanon]] vessel designed by [[Ansel Hsiao]]. Hsiao intended it to be a heavy corvette for escort, reconnaissance, and utility duties of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Hsiao designs">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/3D%20Projects.htm|text=3D Projects: Past, Present, and Future|archivedate=20200116164039}}</ref>

When approached by [[Lucas Licensing]] to provide artwork for ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', Hsiao submitted his own designs in addition to new models, along with their names. The names were recorded in [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Holocron continuity database]], according to the artist.<ref name="Fractalsponge comments">{{WebCite|url=https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&sid=e8501d9d9e2ccc9a1c18226a2628097f&start=1575|text=Something big - Page 64|work=stardestroyer.net|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Xcz6}}</ref> Jason Fry, one of the authors of the book, posted a series of endnotes to the book on his tumblr account. He forgot to record the length of the ''Vigil''-class corvette in part 7 of this series, which detailed the other ships Hsiao designed, and so included it in part 8 as a quick note at the end.<ref name="Endnotes pt. 8" />
